name: relay-helper
description: Answer every Claude Code session on this computer from your phone

scripts.build: bun build --compile --minify --no-compile-autoload-bunfig --no-compile-autoload-dotenv mac/src/hook/client.ts --outfile mac/bin/relay-hook && bun build --compile --minify --no-compile-autoload-bunfig --no-compile-autoload-dotenv mac/src/cli.ts --outfile mac/bin/relay
scripts.test:linux: docker build -q -f Dockerfile.test -t relay-test . && docker run --rm relay-test
scripts.test:linux:x64: docker build -q --platform linux/amd64 -f Dockerfile.test -t relay-test-x64 . && docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 relay-test-x64
